whyItMatters: an ODBC DSN password (PWD) entry is plain text by design, so version control stores it forever and every copy of the tree is a copy of the credential.
actions: Rotate the credential the file holds.
Remove the file from the repository and from image layers.
Provision the file at run time from the platform credential store.
verification: The rotated credential no longer works and the tree contains no file of this shape.
